copy.tagline: 集成 Webex 聊天通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在应用中添加 Webex 消息功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat channel into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Webex messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude 会自动复制 Webex 适配器文件、注册适配器、安装依赖包并运行构建和测试，为项目添加 Cisco Webex 聊天频道集成。你还需要手动创建 Webex 机器人、设置 webhook 和存储凭据。
howto.when: 当你要求添加 Webex 频道集成时，例如说“添加 Webex 支持”或“集成 Webex 聊天”。技能会执行自动步骤，然后提示你完成手动配置。

say.text: 为我的项目添加 Webex 频道
say.note: 自动执行代码集成和依赖安装

say.text: 帮我集成 Webex 聊天
添加 Cisco Webex 支持
say.note: 触发整个流程，但需要你后续手动配置

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude automatically copies the Webex adapter files, registers the adapter, installs the dependency, and runs build and tests to add Cisco Webex channel integration to your project. You then need to manually create a Webex bot, set up a webhook, and store credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Webex channel integration, e.g., 'Add Webex support' or 'Integrate Webex chat'. The skill performs automated steps then prompts you for manual configuration.

say_en.text: Add the Webex channel to my project
say_en.note: Automates code integration and dependency installation
Triggers the whole flow, but you need to manually configure later
